scope: Original AST-extracted functions run using a local Bash/Git executor in a temporary fixture repository. No actual agent, remote sandbox, model, or grading run. user=agent is recorded, not used to change the local OS user. Initial snapshot called directly to model the return from prepare_workspace.

index 7fe73d4..f130532 100644
--- a/source.py
+++ b/source.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 # image setup

calls.cmd:
set -e
cd /tmp/slime-git-diff-reading-r6ga4jhz/repo
agent_index=$(mktemp)
rm -f "$agent_index"
trap 'rm -f "$agent_index" "$agent_index.lock" "$agent_index.paths"' EXIT
export GIT_INDEX_FILE="$agent_index"
git read-tree HEAD
git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard -- . ':(top,exclude)PROBLEM_STATEMENT.md' ':(top,exclude).harness' > "$agent_index.paths"
git update-index --add --remove -z --stdin < "$agent_index.paths"
git write-tree
